mapper.sql: SELECT pa.id, pa.application_no, pa.user_id, pa.dept_id, pa.status, pa.gate_check_json, pa.supplement, pa.dept_approve_by, pa.dept_approve_time, pa.super_approve_by, pa.super_approve_time, pa.reject_reason, pa.cert_no, pa.create_time, pa.update_time, u.user_name AS user_name, u.nick_name AS real_name, u.status AS account_status, u.user_status AS user_status, d.dept_name AS dept_name, p.position_name AS position_name, p.position_code AS position_code, au.nick_name AS dept_approve_name FROM promotion_application pa LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = pa.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = pa.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.user_id = pa.dept_approve_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_application (application_no, user_id, dept_id, status, gate_check_json, supplement, dept_approve_by, dept_approve_time, reject_reason, cert_no, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{status}, #{gateCheckJson}, #{supplement}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_application SET status = #{status}, gate_check_json = #{gateCheckJson}, supplement = #{supplement}, dept_approve_by = #{deptApproveBy}, dept_approve_time = #{deptApproveTime}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, cert_no = #{certNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM promotion_application WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DEPT_PENDING'
